summary: Lightbridge Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 8, 2026, furnishing a shareholder letter and press release under Items 7.01 and 8.01 regarding its selection by the U.S. Department of Energy to participate in the Launch Pad INL program at Idaho National Laboratory, announced August 31, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms; it is a disclosure of a non-financial operational milestone for the advanced nuclear fuel technology company. No deal terms are stated, and no risk-arb angle applies.
